captures.chunks_read: not recorded by the capturing sessions
captures.clock_precision: day only - flagged: a read without an hour cannot anchor a pre-kickoff delta
captures.note: Reconstructed from bytes already in the repository. The desk store is the canonical series; the audit CSV is a second, independent transcription of the same page on the same day. Both are read here read-only; neither is modified by this script.

captures.chunks_read: 0-6 of 8 (the 8th chunk carries only the news module; the last club table closes before its heading)
captures.retrieved_via: fetch_page (rendered markdown of the official page); shell HTTP clients are blocked in this sandbox

policy.delta_is_the_product: levels are stored; deltas are published
policy.hash_target: sha256 of the stored capture bytes
policy.immutable: capture files are append-only; this script never rewrites a capture, it re-derives the index
policy.reserve_list_limit: the weekly report does not carry the IR/reserve list, so an absent row is 'not in this read', never 'available'. Flagged, not resolved.
policy.unit_of_observation: one dated read of one official page, not one week
